supersedes.reason: R02 is a clean-code rerun against the current main after the F1 information-ladder merge and bottleneck diagnosis.
supersedes.artifact_rule: R01 authorization and results are not reusable and must never be pooled with R02.

objective: Validate three explicitly defined M-Lab multi-OD burst load tiers and produce an auditable load table through one formally authorized six-cell consistency matrix; choose a provisional E0 candidate only by the preregistered rule below, then confirm it with additional seeds.
context: This is a load-contract and analysis-chain validation step, not an algorithm comparison.
Each load tier has two identical non-learning cells with the same trace seed and resolved demand override; the paired difference must be zero if the formal chain is deterministic.

The three values are base offered rates before the declared burst. With a 20 s horizon, an 8 s burst starting at 8 s and multiplier 2, the integrated time-average targets are 70, 140 and 280 Mbps for base rates 50, 100 and 200 Mbps.
The result provides duplicate-consistency and raw load evidence for later E0 selection; it does not by itself establish a universal threshold, a cross-tier causal response, or a paper effect.

validity_gate: Every candidate cell must end naturally, report conservation=true, pass governance and satisfy the declared acceptance contract.
A failed validity gate never qualifies a tier; it triggers a follow-up diagnostic instead of silent exclusion.

tier_labels.low: non-congested control point when delivery_rate >= 0.80 and holding-overflow fraction <= 0.05
tier_labels.medium: target operating point when delivery_rate >= 0.20 and < 0.80 and holding-overflow fraction <= 0.20
tier_labels.high: stress/otherwise point for every valid tier that is neither low nor medium (including delivery_rate < 0.20, holding-overflow fraction > 0.20, or the otherwise-unclassified cross-region)

load_selection_rule.measurement: For each cell, holding-overflow fraction = count(fate=HOLDING_QUEUE_OVERFLOW) / total offered packets, where total offered packets is the sum of all packet-fate counts in that receipt; a zero denominator invalidates the cell. For a tier pair, use the lower delivery_rate and higher overflow fraction across its control/copy cells. The pair is invalid if either cell fails the validity gate or the duplicate receipt fate counts/primary metric disagree.
load_selection_rule.selection: Select the lowest valid tier labelled medium as the provisional E0 main-load candidate. If no tier is labelled medium, do not freeze a main load; run a bracket follow-up between the nearest valid tiers (or add 25 Mbps around the nearest boundary) and apply the same rule.
load_selection_rule.confirmation: The provisional candidate is not paper-frozen after this one-seed scan. Re-run it with at least two additional trace seeds; freeze only if the same label holds for both and the paired duplicate checks remain exact.

deliverables: A compiled and independently reviewed six-cell matrix
Receipt-verified VM outputs for all three load pairs
A persisted V2 paired analysis plus immutable run/receipt artifacts from which the preregistered load-selection rule can be recomputed
cannot_claim: A universal or final E0 load threshold
Q0 optimality or a paper-ready statistical conclusion
acceptance: Matrix identity, exact demand intervention path and pair membership pass independent cold review.
All six cells complete naturally on one clean deployed SHA with conservation and acceptance true.
V2 analysis recomputes delivery_rate for all three duplicate pairs and persists a VERIFIED analysis.

For every tier, immutable receipts and V2 artifacts retain the resolved base rate, integrated burst-average target, M-Lab source and endpoint-selection identity, burst transform, offered bits, fates, wall time and raw metric inputs needed for post-run load selection.
